details:
There is something i noticed in latest patches and because i know it hides automatically after ~5 minutes (same for friend invites)

I ask you, do you NOT find it very annoying the icon popup is always ON all the time even you don't want check it right away (especially as streamer or player who don't want rush to accept friend requests - but keep it for future check)

I remember from old times it does auto hide popups after some time. The auto hide seems not work anymore in last patches, so i ask you... why is auto hiding not more working? Bugged now? Removed auto hide function? That is why i post here as bug because i feel this is so weird why it wont hide even i opened and checked who the player is, it's still up above the menu.... still on after 20+ minutes. That is really annoying.

I try look around in the menu options if there is auto hide function somewhere. But i cannot find it. Sure i can accept requests, but i don't accept them immediately (the function below is something i want). Auto hide must restored for this reason.

And... here is old from 2021, don't know why it's showed up and not closed - because its still tracked?: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/hide-friend-request-icon-on-the-hud-after-checking-it-in-the-notifications-menu - please close it if it's already fixed or not more needed with new menu system / hud system.

This feature is very good one. It's highly recommend add it as mode in menu. Because most players don't want visible requests from nowhere. It's also good security point because most sudden requests are ~75% not safe, usually from crashers who send requests to everyone many as possible. https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/accept-friend-requests-option-only-if-the-person-is-in-your-lobby
title: Friend Request popup in Menu Stays on Forever? WHY?
